candidates.name: Universal Agent Runtime core and Rust SDK
candidates.fit_for_gap: Canonical agent, skill, tool, policy, persistence, AG-UI and A2UI runtime

evidence.claim: The local source already provides RunManager, host LlmDriver injection, provider registry, persistence contracts, event replay, cancellation and A2UI continuation.

risks: SDK embedded builder is currently a stub
Server-only dependencies are not yet fully feature-gated
candidates.decision_rationale: Adapt the authoritative runtime rather than reimplementing its domain semantics in KnowMe.

candidates.name: flutter_rust_bridge
candidates.fit_for_gap: Shared Flutter to Rust application-library boundary on Android and iOS

evidence.claim: The project already packages and calls the shared Rust core through FRB on both mobile targets.

candidates.decision_rationale: Keep one existing FFI boundary and place UAR inside the same Rust library.

candidates.name: Android NDK JNI application-owned shared library pattern
candidates.fit_for_gap: Correct native library loading and lifetime on Android

evidence.claim: Android recommends System.loadLibrary, JNI_OnLoad caching, and careful native-thread class-loader handling.
The NDK supports packaging native shared and static libraries into the application.

risks: JNI callbacks from native-created threads need cached JVM/class references
candidates.decision_rationale: Package UAR into KnowMe's existing native library; do not dynamically discover or side-load it.

candidates.name: Xcode native library linking
candidates.fit_for_gap: Correct native library linking for the same embedded kernel on iOS

evidence.claim: Xcode exposes the native linking and interoperability controls used by the existing Flutter/Rust iOS target.

risks: Simulator and device architectures require separate build artifacts
candidates.decision_rationale: Use the same Rust embedded runtime API on iOS and vary only the injected model driver.

build_required.need: Real transport-independent UAR EmbeddedRuntime and SDK facade
build_required.why_no_candidate: The authoritative UAR SDK claims embedded support but currently constructs no runtime state; this must be fixed at the source.

build_required.need: KnowMe host LlmDriver adapters for Android LiteRT-LM and iOS Metal providers
build_required.why_no_candidate: These are application-specific provider bridges over KnowMe's existing inference abstractions.
